{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA will participate in the climate justice movement against the devastation caused by global capitalism on vulnerable people, cultures and ecosystems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s commitment to the climate justice movement aligns with the struggles of indigenous peoples against the plunder of their fossil fuel and forest resources and the pollution of air and water.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA positions itself against the negligent attitude shown by the global North towards black and brown communities disproportionately affected by violent storms, floods and famines caused by carbon emissions from the developed world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Climate justice organizing for DSA chapters will often take the form of campaigns for institutional divestment from fossil fuel capital.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Climate justice organizing for DSA chapters will often take the form of protests and other forms of organized dissent against domestic policies and international agreements that undermine environmental protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing as open socialists gives DSA members the opportunity to organize around widely supported “green” causes under the banner of the anticapitalist “red” movement.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Participation in the climate justice movement enables DSA to stress its internationalist politics.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The climate justice movement is part of a broader fight against corporate domination of social and economic life.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The climate justice movement is part of a broader fight in favor of a democratic international order that enhances global labor, human rights and environmental standards.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In a globalized economy, the commitment of socialists to international solidarity is not just a moral imperative but a pragmatic necessity.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
